question: Who was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Delhi following the 2025 elections?
solution: The correct answer is __**Rekha Gupta**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Following the **Delhi Legislative Assembly Elections** held in **February 2025**, **Rekha Gupta** was sworn in as the **Chief Minister** of the **National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi**. • She represents the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, which secured a majority in the **70-member assembly** by winning more than the required **36 seats**. • The oath of office and secrecy was administered to her by the **Lieutenant Governor of Delhi** at a ceremony held at **Raj Niwas** (or potentially a public venue like **Ramlila Maidan**). • Her appointment followed the conclusion of the term of the previous assembly, where the transition of power occurred from the **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** to the **BJP**. ***Hence, the statement regarding her swearing-in is correct.*** • **Rekha Gupta** is a seasoned politician who has previously served as a **Corporator** and held significant positions within the **Delhi University Students' Union (DUSU)** in the **mid-1990s**.
